xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3943: Toggleable Deft Directive compatibility profile and skill bundle

plan.title: Toggleable Deft Directive compatibility profile and skill bundle
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Deft Directive is a process engine that installs by writing tracked repo files (AGENTS.md section, hooks, .githooks + core.hooksPath, package pin, xbrief/). Operators need Deft guidance on for selected work without Deft taking over a project, and a way to switch an existing Directive deposit off per issue, without Overdeck ever writing tracked repo state.
narratives.Proposal: Build on PAN-3942/PAN-4334: a deft-readonly adapter mounts 7 engine-free Deft skills (prefix stripped, host notice injected) per launch, with Claude permissions.deny against Deft's mutating CLIs in non-Directive projects; a versioned 25-skill map replaces PAN-791; read-only Directive-project detection and an ownership/collision report; an explicit deft pack off at project or issue level in a Directive project exports DEFT_DIRECTIVE_DISABLE=1, writes a marked untracked flag file only inside issue worktrees, and hides the deposit's pointer skills; managed mode (pan skills deft enable|disable --project, gated on detection plus a printed plan digest) exports DEFT_ORCHESTRATOR=overdeck. Provenance appears in pan skills deft status and a [launcher] deft: stderr line. Fork work (PAN-4425) and dashboard controls (PAN-4426) are sibling issues.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Replacing Overdeck's planner, worktree lifecycle, review pipeline, or xBRIEF source of truth with Deft
- Running directive init/update/bootstrap, deft session:start, or any Deft CLI from Overdeck code; installing @deftai/directive anywhere
- Writing tracked files, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md sections, agent hook files, .githooks, core.hooksPath, or package.json in any project
- Migrating Overdeck projects into Directive or uninstalling a user's Directive deposit
- Changes in the eltmon/directive fork (PAN-4425) and dashboard API/UI controls (PAN-4426)
- Any issue, PR, or comment on deftai/* repositories
- A conversation-level toggle (PAN-3942 has global/project/issue only)
- Full Deft orchestration where Deft owns worktrees, review, or merge
- Mounting Deft hooks, MCP servers, or commands
- Polyrepo sub-repo Directive detection
- Changing Overdeck's existing .claude/settings.json hook merge during workspace creation (reported only)
- SageOx and Matt Pocock pack changes

autoDecisions.summary: Fork work in eltmon/directive (env-var off switch, external-orchestrator mode) split into sibling PAN-4425
autoDecisions.rationale: The Overdeck pipeline reviews only the eltmon/overdeck PR; fork commits cannot be reviewed or Item-trailered here. Overdeck exports the env vars as no-ops until the fork engine is pinned, and the flag file works on engines >= v0.92.0.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard controls split into sibling PAN-4426; this issue delivers the explicit project-level action through pan skills deft enable/disable
autoDecisions.rationale: Route, no-loss-matrix row, component and mount would exceed the 25-file finalize limit; the CLI already enforces detection plus a printed plan before enabling.

autoDecisions.summary: No conversation level; conversations inherit global/project toggles
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3942 was rescoped to global/project/issue; conversation launches run the same launch step with a managedStateKey.

autoDecisions.summary: The deft pack must be registered before its toggle can be set
autoDecisions.rationale: The PAN-4334 store rejects unknown packs; pan skills deft status prints the add command.

autoDecisions.summary: Kill switch only on explicit off (issue/project), never on the default
autoDecisions.rationale: Pack toggles default to off; applying the kill switch on default would silently disable every user's Directive deposit.

autoDecisions.summary: Flag file written only in feature-<issue> worktrees, with an ownership marker
autoDecisions.rationale: A flag in the primary checkout would silence Deft for every session there; the marker lets Overdeck remove only flags it wrote.

autoDecisions.summary: Capability boundary = host notice in every mounted SKILL.md plus Claude permissions.deny for Deft CLIs in non-Directive projects
autoDecisions.rationale: Several allowlisted skills name task/deft commands or xbrief/ writes; Codex has no deny mechanism so the notice is the shared layer.
Operator plan 2026-09-29: pack sources point at the forks; the operator still picks --ref and approves the commit.

autoDecisions.summary: Read-only allowlist is the 7 skills from PAN-4334 section 3.2 (glossary, debug, design-critique, gh-arch, write-skill, probe, cost)
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4334 research counted CLI dependencies per SKILL.md; re-verified the 25-skill set at eltmon/directive 48e8cbf.

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-4: create src/lib/deft/detect.ts exporting DirectiveDetection, detectDirectiveProject(root), and findRepoRoot(cwd) (fs walk to the first dir holding a .git entry). Fields: coreVersion, pinnedEngine, managedSection, agentHookFiles (deft-hook in the four host files), gitHooksPath (async execFile git config --get core.hooksPath, 5000 ms timeout, null on failure), hasGithooksDir, pointerSkills (deft-directive-* under .claude/skills, .agents/skills, .codex/skills), xbriefProjectDefinition, killSwitch {present, overdeckOwned via first line '# overdeck:deft-directive-disable'}, permanentOptOut, killSwitchSupported (>= 0.92.0; null when unparseable). isDirectiveProject = coreVersion || managedSection || pinnedEngine. Spawn `git config` only when a fs signal (coreVersion, managedSection, or pinnedEngine) is present, so a plain project launch spawns nothing. Never writes. Tests in src/lib/deft/__tests__/detect.test.ts.

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-7: create src/lib/deft/launch.ts exporting DeftLaunchPlan, resolveDeftLaunch(ctx), applyDeftLaunch(plan, root, envFile), DEFT_FLAG_MARKER, and DEFT_CLI_DENY.
